title: Stand up the unit test target
acceptance: A unit test target exists and is wired into the Stacks scheme's test action
At least one real assertion runs against existing extractor code
The suite is runnable from one command and reports pass/fail via exit code
No existing target's build settings, bundle ids, or signing config are modified
notes: Bootstrap: built in-session, not dispatched — the factory cannot verify the thing that makes verification possible. Shape depends on D-0001.
